name: Marjoram

low.description: About 1-2 tablespoons fresh or 1 teaspoon dried

siboNotes: Fresh or dried marjoram is well-tolerated and can help add flavor without triggering SIBO symptoms.
preparationTips: Add fresh marjoram at end of cooking to preserve delicate flavor
Dry marjoram has more concentrated flavor - use about 1/3 the amount
Store fresh marjoram in refrigerator wrapped in damp paper towel
Crush dried marjoram between fingers to release oils before adding to dishes
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants including rosmarinic acid
Good source of vitamin K for bone health
